note:
HUNG ON THE SIGN'S BEAM at x480. THE HOOK IS REMOVED ENTIRELY -- the lantern's own collar and finial meet the timber directly, which reads as fixed to the beam. A drawn hook cut off at the beam line still read as a lantern with a piece missing.

every foreground light in Room 1 left with somebody. The coach's two lamps depart at beat 6b and Hob's lantern goes with him, so after beat 9 the near half of the frame was lit by nothing -- and the title plays over a walk through that mud.

The pool is ADDITIVE and drawn after the plate, before the characters, like Hob's -- but FIXED, because this lamp does not travel. Wider than his (3.4x rather than 2.6x) and dimmer (0.72 against 0.85), because a lamp on a beam is higher up and further off than one carried at hip height.
